findings.claim: BoM↔mesh coverage is 100% for blender / GA / SLD
findings.observed: Re-run: BLE 23/23 (100%), GA 23/23 (100%), SLD 6/6 (100%); n_gapped=0; orphan_equipment=[]; matches prior snapshot exactly
findings.reader_would_conclude: Every ledger part expected on render/GA/SLD is checked present in the coverage matrix

findings.claim: FPK ontology→mesh coverage is complete (all first-principles parts meshed)
findings.observed: covered=48/48 ontology_count, score=1.0, missing=[], mesh_count=194, ok=true; ship_ok remains false (hardcoded on persist in fpk_blender_coverage.py)
findings.reader_would_conclude: All 48 FPK part IDs have at least one matching mesh name

findings.claim: Every mesh has a corresponding parts-ledger line (reverse coverage)
findings.where: form-meshes.json meshes vs ONTOLOGY_MESH_MAP vs parts-ledger equipment
findings.command: python3 reverse analysis: 194 meshes × ONTOLOGY_MESH_MAP × ledger fuzzy name match
findings.observed: 95/194 meshes have no ontology pattern (fasteners/ribs/PE detail/vehicle stubs). 19 ontology parts with meshes (geartrain: sun/planet/ring/diff/halfshafts/seals/encoder/…) have no dedicated ledger row — collapsed mainly into X-117 Reduction gear stage. Not a BLE matrix miss, but reverse 1:1 mesh↔ledger line fails at geartrain granularity.
findings.reader_would_conclude: Scene has many detail meshes and multi-mesh gear assemblies not itemised as separate BoM/ledger lines

findings.claim: 00-hero is a shippable closed-product flagship render
findings.observed: Hero shows open/disassembled assembly (end cover removed, copper windings and internals exposed), thin bar floating above unit, multiple rails and bolt-like parts lying detached on the ground plane, incomplete shaft/interface stubs. Not a sealed MGU exterior.
findings.reader_would_conclude: Product is unfinished, exploded on the floor, or a cutaway left in the hero slot

findings.claim: Ghost shell (08) cleanly shows internals without debris or floaters
findings.observed: Smoked-shell transparency works and internals (windings, shaft) read, but same ground-plane rails/bolts and overhead floating bar remain; assembly still looks partially disassembled rather than ghosted sealed product.
findings.reader_would_conclude: Ghost view is useful but littered with unattached hardware

findings.claim: Exploded (13) is a coherent manufacturing explode without stray solids
findings.observed: Axial explode of housing/rotor/cover is readable, but RGB phase bars look like toy blocks, MCU board floats with weak mechanical story, small fasteners float in space, floor rails still present under the pad.
findings.reader_would_conclude: Exploded view is schematic/Lego-like in places rather than engineering-grade

findings.claim: Parts catalogue (14) presents recognisable engineered components
findings.observed: Grid, shadows, and labels are clean and complete. Many entries are featureless boxes/plates/discs (e.g. flat slabs labelled SiC Inverter / Inverter Housing / Pack Base). Good mesh inventory; weak part-identity storytelling.
findings.reader_would_conclude: Catalogue proves mesh count more than manufacturing-ready part geometry

findings.claim: Closed exterior product renders have no detached ground debris
findings.observed: Main housing is more sealed than hero, but long dark rails and small bolt-like solids still sit on the ground plane disconnected from the pack (consistent with pack-base rail / mount-bolt meshes not constrained to the assembly).
findings.reader_would_conclude: Even the 'closed product' shot has loose hardware on the floor

findings.claim: Render path is Blender universal builder with documented engine
findings.observed: Path: Blender 5.1.1 background → build_universal_scene.py (UNIVERSAL, no formula_e_front_mgu template). Hero tagged Cycles; ghost pass code forces Cycles; EEVEE used/restored for other passes. Product 4800×3200, catalogue 7200×4800. Prior bg run: shaded hero timeout 900s then fallback.
findings.reader_would_conclude: Current key product PNGs come from universal Cycles/EEVEE hybrid studio path, latest isatags rerender 2026-08-03

findings.claim: Automated image quality / vision gates catch these defects
findings.command: evaluate_image on key PNGs; read render-vision-critique.json; drawing-gates.json
findings.observed: evaluate_image passed all five key images (occupancy/edges only). drawing-gates renders=pass. vision critique ok=true on 04 only, defects=[], and structured_defects_error ModuleNotFoundError: vision_route_fix. Floating debris and open-hero state not gated.
findings.reader_would_conclude: Deterministic/vision gates can report green while hero/exterior still look broken

summary: Re-derived BoM coverage confirms BLE/GA/SLD 100% and FPK ontology 48/48 meshes; reverse check finds 95 detail meshes outside ontology map and 19 geartrain ontology parts without dedicated ledger lines. Render path is Blender 5.1.1 universal build_universal_scene (Cycles hero/ghost, EEVEE hybrid). Visual open of 00/08/13/14 (plus 04) fails ship: hero is open/disassembled with floor debris and floaters; ghost/exterior share ground-plane litter; exploded looks toy-like in places; catalogue is neat but primitive-heavy. Automated quality gates pass anyway — RENDERS ok=false, ship_ok still false.
